profile.headline: Sr. Data Engineer at Core & Main
profile.summary: Experienced software professional with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Business Processes, Requirements Analysis, Front and back-end application development, and database development including tables, procedures, functions, triggers, tuning, and performance evaluations. Strong operations professional with knowledge of SDLC. As a consultant, I can communicate at the executive level, business level, and developer level. Have led projects (using various methodologies)  and multi-discipline teams.

positions.title: Sr. Data Engineer/Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the migration of all data from an old ERP to D365.  This includes mapping extraction, transformation and importing into D365, complete with auditing and full traceback reporting.

Developed a set of python scripts to automate the migration to a simple press of a button for each entity being migrated or extraction of validation data from D365 saving many hours or work. Automated a set of 65 Pre and post migration reports that automatically generate on a weekly basis to catch data that needs attention with er before or after a migration.

Environment is Azure, Synapse Analytics, SQL Server, Python, Microsoft D365

positions.title: Partner and Sr Software Consultant
positions.description: Worked with multiple clients to solve business critical issues through software changes or the development of new software.  This included frontend and backend software development work and frequently migrating data from one platform to another. Each of these projects included gathering requirements, architecting a solution, preparing project costs and time frames, and communicating with upper management, business, and other developers (onshore and offshore). Many projects crossed several platforms and environments.

positions.description: Worked as a consultant with an automotive manufacturing firm to improve the software development process as well as designing and developing software for internal use. positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description: Led a 28-member development group consisting of PowerBuilder and C developers, documentation specialists, and QA team to stabilize and maintain a multi-tier client-server software product with Web-based components for the time and attendance industry. Participated in proposal generation and presentations for customizations. Directed the standardization of the development effort by implementing the tool for a successful software development lifecycle implementation.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL Tuning · Databases · Technical Leadership · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Programming · Software Development

positions.title: Senior Software Development Manager
positions.description: Starting as a Project Leader and moved up to the Development Architect and then into the Development Manager role where I led a 33-person team consisting of Developers, Architects, Technical Writers, and QA staff members to develop an application to adjudicate healthcare claims-based on procedures and coverage rules for the member. This included the budgeting and scheduling of activities, employee reviews, business requirements gathering, writing technical specifications, and resolving infrastructure issues.  It also allowed me to communicate and present plans and progress to upper management regularly.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Leadership · Enterprise Software · Oral Communication · Software Development · Software Project Management
